# CPIN.JK — DISCARD (IDEATION 2026-11-06)

House coverage v2 carries a BUY at Rp3,650 against Rp2,370 (2026-11-04). The fast-disqualify check on the target is a clean **no**.

**The two 50% halves disagree by 3x.** The DCF (FCFF) leg — the only leg priced off cash flows — produces Rp1,635.7, i.e. **−31% against the price**. The P/E leg produces Rp5,034.8 and the EV/EBITDA leg Rp5,057.9, both flagged in the model itself as **+208% and +209% versus the primary**. Those two legs are built on "average of peer median and own five-year average" multiples: the own-five-year-average half is an anchor to past prices, not to value. Strip the price-anchored legs and the house's own valuation work says the stock is expensive at 2,370.

Back-of-envelope EV at the registry prior (`derated_compounder_rerating`, 0.40/+50/−30) is +2.0%, which is too thin to carry a valuation case that the primary method rejects.

**Archetype guess:** `derated_compounder_rerating` · method card: VAL_COMPOUNDER_QUALITY.

**What would re-open it:** a DCF whose FY2026-28 FCFF path is re-based on the poultry-cycle feed margin (CPIN's FY2025 gross margin 17.6% versus 14.3% in FY2023), so the primary method alone clears the price — or a price at or below the DCF value. Neither holds today, so no depth is spent on Saturday.
